paragraphs.source_en: When Yuasa Gosuke struck off Ōtani Yoshitsugu's head with a single blow, the Battle of Sekigahara had been decisively settled. Miura Kitayū, who was there, hurriedly wrapped the severed head in his clothing and rushed away. But Miura Kitayū and Yuasa Gosuke were both killed soon afterward, so no one ever learned what became of Yoshitsugu's head.

units.source_en: When Yuasa Gosuke struck off Ōtani Yoshitsugu's head with a single blow, the Battle of Sekigahara had been decisively settled.
units.source_zh: 当大谷吉继的首级被汤浅五助一刀砍落时，关原合战的胜负已完全决出。

units.source_en: Miura Kitayū, who was there, hurriedly wrapped the severed head in his clothing and rushed away.
units.source_zh: 在场的三浦喜太夫急忙把五助砍下的首级包在衣服里，匆匆离去。

units.source_en: But Miura Kitayū and Yuasa Gosuke were both killed soon afterward, so no one ever learned what became of Yoshitsugu's head.
units.source_zh: 但三浦喜太夫和汤浅五助随后也都战死，因此，吉继的首级究竟落于何处，无人知晓。

paragraphs.source_zh: 当大谷吉继的首级被汤浅五助一刀砍落时，关原合战的胜负已完全决出。在场的三浦喜太夫急忙把五助砍下的首级包在衣服里，匆匆离去。但三浦喜太夫和汤浅五助随后也都战死，因此，吉继的首级究竟落于何处，无人知晓。

paragraphs.source_en: By then, the course of the battle had changed completely. Kobayakawa's forces sweeping down from Mount Matsuo joined the contingents of Wakisaka Yasuharu, Kutsuki Mototsuna, Ogawa Suketada, Akaza Naoyasu, and others who had defected to the Eastern Army; together they charged Ukita's troops below Mount Tenma, then attacked the routed remnants of Konishi Yukinaga's force to the north.

units.source_en: By then, the course of the battle had changed completely.
units.source_zh: 此时战局已完全变了。

units.source_en: Kobayakawa's forces sweeping down from Mount Matsuo joined the contingents of Wakisaka Yasuharu, Kutsuki Mototsuna, Ogawa Suketada, Akaza Naoyasu, and others who had defected to the Eastern Army; together they charged Ukita's troops below Mount Tenma, then attacked the routed remnants of Konishi Yukinaga's force to the north.
units.source_zh: 从松尾山上杀下来的小早川的人马，与投靠了东军的胁坂安治、朽木元纲、小川佑忠、赤座直保等部，直接向天满山下的宇喜多部杀去，然后又向北面小西行长的残兵败将发动了袭击。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时战局已完全变了。从松尾山上杀下来的小早川的人马，与投靠了东军的胁坂安治、朽木元纲、小川佑忠、赤座直保等部，直接向天满山下的宇喜多部杀去，然后又向北面小西行长的残兵败将发动了袭击。

paragraphs.source_en: Before the motionless Shimazu position, the Eastern and Western armies became entangled in a melee. At this point, moving or remaining still made no difference at all. The only question now was who would be first to take Shimazu Yoshihiro's head.

units.source_en: Before the motionless Shimazu position, the Eastern and Western armies became entangled in a melee.
units.source_zh: 按兵不动的岛津阵地前面，东西两军陷入混战。

units.source_en: At this point, moving or remaining still made no difference at all.
units.source_zh: 此时动与不动完全没有分别。

units.source_en: The only question now was who would be first to take Shimazu Yoshihiro's head.

ja.t: るかということだけだった。

units.source_zh: 现在的问题是，究竟谁会最先拿到岛津义弘的首级。

paragraphs.source_zh: 按兵不动的岛津阵地前面，东西两军陷入混战。此时动与不动完全没有分别。现在的问题是，究竟谁会最先拿到岛津义弘的首级。

paragraphs.source_en: Though sixty-six years old, Shimazu Yoshihiro's mettle was undiminished from his prime. He had likely held his troops in place so as not to waste a shred of strength before the final struggle.

units.source_en: Though sixty-six years old, Shimazu Yoshihiro's mettle was undiminished from his prime.
units.source_zh: 虽说年已六十六，岛津义弘豪气依然不逊壮年。

units.source_en: He had likely held his troops in place so as not to waste a shred of strength before the final struggle.

ja.t: かさなかったのは、おそらく

units.source_zh: 他一直按兵不动，恐是为了不浪费一丝力气，为最后的决战作准备。

paragraphs.source_zh: 虽说年已六十六，岛津义弘豪气依然不逊壮年。他一直按兵不动，恐是为了不浪费一丝力气，为最后的决战作准备。

paragraphs.source_en: “Report! Ishida's troops are collapsing toward Mount Ibuki, and the ground before our lines is filled with fleeing soldiers.”

units.source_en: “Report!
Ishida's troops are collapsing toward Mount Ibuki, and the ground before our lines is filled with fleeing soldiers.”
units.source_zh: 石田部正向伊吹山方向溃败，我军阵前全是溃逃的士兵。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “报！石田部正向伊吹山方向溃败，我军阵前全是溃逃的士兵。”

paragraphs.source_en: After hearing Kawakami Sakyō-no-suke's report, Yoshihiro asked, “What hour is it?”

units.source_en: After hearing Kawakami Sakyō-no-suke's report, Yoshihiro asked, “What hour is it?”
units.source_zh: 听了川上左京亮的报告，义弘问道：“现在什么时辰？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 听了川上左京亮的报告，义弘问道：“现在什么时辰？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Around the Hour of the Goat.”

units.source_en: “Around the Hour of the Goat.”
units.source_zh: “未时左右。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “未时左右。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Good. Bring my horse.” Only then did Yoshihiro rise. He had foreseen this outcome long ago. With only two thousand men, he had never had any chance of victory.

units.source_en: “Good. Bring my horse.”
units.source_zh: “好，牵马。”

units.source_en: Only then did Yoshihiro rise.
units.source_zh: 义弘这才站了起来。

units.source_en: He had foreseen this outcome long ago.
units.source_zh: 他早就预料到这种结局。

units.source_en: With only two thousand men, he had never had any chance of victory.

ja.t: などあるはずもなかった。

units.source_zh: 自己的人马不过两千，绝无胜机。

paragraphs.source_zh: “好，牵马。”义弘这才站了起来。他早就预料到这种结局。自己的人马不过两千，绝无胜机。

paragraphs.source_en: Toyohisa and Chōjuin galloped up, drenched and spattered with mud.

units.source_en: Toyohisa and Chōjuin galloped up, drenched and spattered with mud.
units.source_zh: 丰久和长寿院飞马赶来，一身泥水。

paragraphs.source_zh: 丰久和长寿院飞马赶来，一身泥水。

paragraphs.source_en: “Chūsho, who is the fiercest among the enemy?”

units.source_en: “Chūsho, who is the fiercest among the enemy?”
units.source_zh: “中书，敌人中最勇猛的是谁？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “中书，敌人中最勇猛的是谁？”

paragraphs.source_en: Toyohisa faltered, unable at once to grasp Yoshihiro's meaning. “Do you mean the man who has won the greatest distinction?”

units.source_en: Toyohisa faltered, unable at once to grasp Yoshihiro's meaning. “Do you mean the man who has won the greatest distinction?”
units.source_zh: 丰久一愣，没能立刻明白义弘此话的意思，“您指的是战功第一？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 丰久一愣，没能立刻明白义弘此话的意思，“您指的是战功第一？”

paragraphs.source_en: “No. I am asking who looks the most ferocious now.”

units.source_en: “No.
I am asking who looks the most ferocious now.”
units.source_zh: 我问现在看上去最凶猛的家伙是谁？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “不。我问现在看上去最凶猛的家伙是谁？”

paragraphs.source_en: “The Lord of the Interior's main force, of course... Apart from Ii and Honda, scarcely any of them have entered the fighting yet.”

units.source_en: “The Lord of the Interior's main force, of course... Apart from Ii and Honda, scarcely any of them have entered the fighting yet.”

ja.t: けば、ほかはまだほとんど

units.source_zh: “当然是内府的主力……除了井伊和本多，其他的几乎还没参战呢。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “当然是内府的主力……除了井伊和本多，其他的几乎还没参战呢。”

paragraphs.source_en: At that, Yoshihiro glanced at Toyohisa, who seemed about to unfasten his armor. Yoshihiro said, “Chūsho! What are you doing?”

units.source_en: At that, Yoshihiro glanced at Toyohisa, who seemed about to unfasten his armor.

ja.t: こうとしているようだった。

units.source_zh: 言罢，义弘看了一眼丰久，丰久似要解开甲胄。

units.source_en: Yoshihiro said, “Chūsho!
units.source_zh: 义弘道：“中书！

units.source_en: What are you doing?”
units.source_zh: 你干什么？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 言罢，义弘看了一眼丰久，丰久似要解开甲胄。义弘道：“中书！你干什么？”

paragraphs.source_en: “My lord has resolved to go to his death, so your nephew must make certain preparations.”

units.source_en: “My lord has resolved to go to his death, so your nephew must make certain preparations.”
units.source_zh: “大人决意要赴死，侄儿便要作些准备。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “大人决意要赴死，侄儿便要作些准备。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Fool! I said I would charge into the Lord of the Interior's camp and die fighting, not commit seppuku here. Your ears must have deceived you.”

units.source_en: “Fool!
units.source_zh: “混账！

units.source_en: I said I would charge into the Lord of the Interior's camp and die fighting, not commit seppuku here.
units.source_zh: 我刚才说的是要杀进内府营中战死，不是要在此切腹。

units.source_en: Your ears must have deceived you.”
units.source_zh: 我看你是耳朵听差了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “混账！我刚才说的是要杀进内府营中战死，不是要在此切腹。我看你是耳朵听差了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Your nephew heard correctly. Now that my lord is finally going to charge out, I wish to exchange armor with you.”

units.source_en: “Your nephew heard correctly.
units.source_zh: “侄儿未听错。

units.source_en: Now that my lord is finally going to charge out, I wish to exchange armor with you.”
units.source_zh: 大人终于要杀出去了，侄儿想与大人交换甲胄。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “侄儿未听错。大人终于要杀出去了，侄儿想与大人交换甲胄。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Why?”

units.source_en: “Why?”
units.source_zh: “为何？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “为何？”

paragraphs.source_en: Toyohisa removed his armor and said, “Quickly, please exchange armor with me. If my lord charges into the enemy camp bent on death, while I knowingly stand by and let him be killed, will not posterity laugh at me?”

units.source_en: Toyohisa removed his armor and said, “Quickly, please exchange armor with me.
units.source_zh: 丰久解了甲胄，道：“快，请赶紧与侄儿交换甲胄。

units.source_en: If my lord charges into the enemy camp bent on death, while I knowingly stand by and let him be killed, will not posterity laugh at me?”

ja.t: われるではありませんか」

units.source_zh: 大人抱着赴死之心杀进敌营，而侄儿明知大人会战死，却坐视不管，传到后世，岂不被人笑话？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 丰久解了甲胄，道：“快，请赶紧与侄儿交换甲胄。大人抱着赴死之心杀进敌营，而侄儿明知大人会战死，却坐视不管，传到后世，岂不被人笑话？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Toyohisa, are you mocking me?”

units.source_en: “Toyohisa, are you mocking me?”
units.source_zh: “丰久，你是在嘲笑我？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “丰久，你是在嘲笑我？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Ha ha ha! Chūsho has quite a way with words.”

units.source_en: “Ha ha ha! Chūsho has quite a way with words.”
units.source_zh: “哈哈哈，中书倒能言会道。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “哈哈哈，中书倒能言会道。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Please, change armor at once.”

units.source_en: “Please, change armor at once.”
units.source_zh: “请快换甲。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “请快换甲。”

paragraphs.source_en: Toyohisa glanced up at Yoshihiro and put his armor back on, for he knew his uncle's fierce temperament. Once armored, he held out his hand before Yoshihiro. “Then, Uncle, please give me your battle surcoat as promised.”

units.source_en: Toyohisa glanced up at Yoshihiro and put his armor back on, for he knew his uncle's fierce temperament.
units.source_zh: 丰久抬头瞥一眼义弘，重又穿回盔甲，他知叔父刚烈性情。

units.source_en: Once armored, he held out his hand before Yoshihiro.
units.source_zh: 穿好盔甲，他把手伸到义弘面前。

units.source_en: “Then, Uncle, please give me your battle surcoat as promised.”
units.source_zh: “那么，请叔父如约把阵羽织交与侄儿。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 丰久抬头瞥一眼义弘，重又穿回盔甲，他知叔父刚烈性情。穿好盔甲，他把手伸到义弘面前。“那么，请叔父如约把阵羽织交与侄儿。”

paragraphs.source_en: “What promise?”

units.source_en: “What promise?”
units.source_zh: “什么约定？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “什么约定？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Please give me your battle surcoat. You said only that I was to put my armor back on.”

units.source_en: “Please give me your battle surcoat.
units.source_zh: “请您把阵羽织给侄儿。

units.source_en: You said only that I was to put my armor back on.”

ja.t: ろとしかおっしゃいませんでした」

units.source_zh: 您刚才只说，要侄儿穿好铠甲。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “请您把阵羽织给侄儿。您刚才只说，要侄儿穿好铠甲。”

paragraphs.source_en: “At a time like this, you still resort to clever tricks!”

units.source_en: “At a time like this, you still resort to clever tricks!”
units.source_zh: “都什么时候了，你还耍小聪明！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “都什么时候了，你还耍小聪明！”

paragraphs.source_en: “What do you intend?”

units.source_en: “What do you intend?”
units.source_zh: “你怎样想？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你怎样想？”

paragraphs.source_en: Shimazu Yoshihiro fixed Toyohisa with a stare so fierce that his eyes seemed ready to burst. “You had even planned this far ahead?”

units.source_en: Shimazu Yoshihiro fixed Toyohisa with a stare so fierce that his eyes seemed ready to burst.
units.source_zh: 岛津义弘死死盯着丰久，眼睛如要爆裂一般。

units.source_en: “You had even planned this far ahead?”
units.source_zh: “你连这一步都考虑到了？”

paragraphs.source_zh: 岛津义弘死死盯着丰久，眼睛如要爆裂一般。“你连这一步都考虑到了？”

paragraphs.source_en: The light rain soaked Toyohisa's hair, but he continued to meet Yoshihiro's gaze unwaveringly. After a long standoff, Yoshihiro finally stripped off his battle surcoat and flung it before Toyohisa.

units.source_en: The light rain soaked Toyohisa's hair, but he continued to meet Yoshihiro's gaze unwaveringly.
units.source_zh: 小雨打湿了丰久的头发，可他仍然坚定地盯着义弘。

units.source_en: After a long standoff, Yoshihiro finally stripped off his battle surcoat and flung it before Toyohisa.
units.source_zh: 僵持了多时，义弘才把阵羽织脱下，扔到丰久面前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 小雨打湿了丰久的头发，可他仍然坚定地盯着义弘。僵持了多时，义弘才把阵羽织脱下，扔到丰久面前。

paragraphs.source_en: “I humbly thank you for the gift, my lord.”

units.source_en: “I humbly thank you for the gift, my lord.”
units.source_zh: “多谢大人赏赐。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “多谢大人赏赐。”

paragraphs.source_en: Seeing Toyohisa receive the battle surcoat, Chōjuin Morikiyo, who stood nearby, also came forward. “My lord, please bestow your standard upon me.”

units.source_en: Seeing Toyohisa receive the battle surcoat, Chōjuin Morikiyo, who stood nearby, also came forward.
units.source_zh: 见丰久得到阵羽织，一旁的长寿院盛淳也凑了过来。

units.source_en: “My lord, please bestow your standard upon me.”
units.source_zh: “请大人把马印赏与在下。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 见丰久得到阵羽织，一旁的长寿院盛淳也凑了过来。“请大人把马印赏与在下。”

paragraphs.source_en: “You want even my standard?”

units.source_en: “You want even my standard?”
units.source_zh: “你连我的马印都要？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你连我的马印都要？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. Better still if my lord would also bestow his war fan upon me.”

units.source_en: “Yes.
Better still if my lord would also bestow his war fan upon me.”
units.source_zh: 大人能把军扇也赏给在下，更好。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是。大人能把军扇也赏给在下，更好。”

paragraphs.source_en: Yoshihiro's war fan was one Mitsunari had distributed to the commanders at Ōgaki Castle. Without a word, Yoshihiro removed the standard and war fan from his back and handed them to Morikiyo. “Take them. Go.” Then he drew the sword at his waist and raised it high above his head.

units.source_en: Yoshihiro's war fan was one Mitsunari had distributed to the commanders at Ōgaki Castle.
units.source_zh: 义弘那军扇乃是三成在大垣城内分发给诸将的。

units.source_en: Without a word, Yoshihiro removed the standard and war fan from his back and handed them to Morikiyo. “Take them. Go.”
units.source_zh: 义弘默然把背上的马印和军扇拔下，交给盛淳，道：“给你，去吧。”

units.source_en: Then he drew the sword at his waist and raised it high above his head.
units.source_zh: 随后，他摘下挂在腰间的刀，高高举过头顶。

paragraphs.source_zh: 义弘那军扇乃是三成在大垣城内分发给诸将的。义弘默然把背上的马印和军扇拔下，交给盛淳，道：“给你，去吧。”随后，他摘下挂在腰间的刀，高高举过头顶。

paragraphs.source_en: The others likewise drew their swords. The wind and rain grew ever fiercer, lashing the naked blades held aloft. With a thunderous cry, the Shimazu troops, led by Yoshihiro, swept upon Ieyasu's lines with the speed of a thunderbolt.

units.source_en: The others likewise drew their swords.
units.source_zh: 众人也纷纷抽刀出鞘。

units.source_en: The wind and rain grew ever fiercer, lashing the naked blades held aloft.
units.source_zh: 风雨愈来愈大，吹打着高高举过头顶的白刃。

units.source_en: With a thunderous cry, the Shimazu troops, led by Yoshihiro, swept upon Ieyasu's lines with the speed of a thunderbolt.
units.source_zh: 呐喊声起，岛津的人马在义弘的率领下，以迅雷不及掩耳之势杀到家康阵前。

paragraphs.source_zh: 众人也纷纷抽刀出鞘。风雨愈来愈大，吹打着高高举过头顶的白刃。呐喊声起，岛津的人马在义弘的率领下，以迅雷不及掩耳之势杀到家康阵前。

paragraphs.source_en: Believing nearly all the Western Army had already been driven toward Mount Ibuki, the Eastern vanguard split in two before this sudden torrent and opened a path.

units.source_en: Believing nearly all the Western Army had already been driven toward Mount Ibuki, the Eastern vanguard split in two before this sudden torrent and opened a path.
units.source_zh: 本以为西军几乎都被追赶到伊吹山方向去了，面对这股突如其来的洪流，东军前锋顿时一分为二，让出一条道。

paragraphs.source_zh: 本以为西军几乎都被追赶到伊吹山方向去了，面对这股突如其来的洪流，东军前锋顿时一分为二，让出一条道。

paragraphs.source_en: For a time, even Sakai's and Tsutsui's contingents could not tell whether the oncoming men were friend or foe. Any force caught unawares will fall into confusion. Confronted by troops charging like demons from north to south, the Eastern Army took a long time to react. By the time they finally realized it was the Shimazu army, much time had already passed. The Eastern vanguard had advanced as far as the Teratani River west of the highway; the Shimazu assault had come at precisely the right moment.

units.source_en: For a time, even Sakai's and Tsutsui's contingents could not tell whether the oncoming men were friend or foe.
units.source_zh: 酒井和筒井各部竟也一时未弄清来人究竟是敌是友。

units.source_en: Any force caught unawares will fall into confusion.
units.source_zh: 但凡被打个措手不及，就会陷入混乱。

units.source_en: Confronted by troops charging like demons from north to south, the Eastern Army took a long time to react.
units.source_zh: 面对着似恶魔般由北向南突袭而来的人马，东军许久未反应过来。

units.source_en: By the time they finally realized it was the Shimazu army, much time had already passed.
units.source_zh: 当他们终于弄明白乃是岛津之军，已过去多时了。

units.source_en: The Eastern vanguard had advanced as far as the Teratani River west of the highway; the Shimazu assault had come at precisely the right moment.
units.source_zh: 东军先锋已经进发到官道以西的寺谷川一线，岛津的突袭正是时候。

paragraphs.source_en: With battle cries, the Eastern Army swept around the Shimazu troops, who were forced to cover themselves with arquebus fire. Sekigahara village was almost before them, but unbeknownst to Shimazu, a formidable force had already quietly cut off their retreat—Ii Naomasa, who had once advanced against Ishida's troops and had now fallen back. Naomasa laughed heartily. “I knew that old Shimazu fox would try something like this.”

paragraphs.source_en: South of Sekigahara lies the Makita River, formed where the Teratani and Fuji rivers meet; the road along its bank is called the Makita Road. Ii Naomasa intended to pursue Shimazu to the Makita Road and strike them there, whatever it took.

paragraphs.source_en: With Naomasa never leaving his side, Matsudaira Tadayoshi had no choice but to pursue the enemy with great reluctance. paragraphs.source_en: Leaving Naomasa behind, Matsudaira Tadayoshi recklessly charged into the enemy formation. His target was none other than the veteran general Shimazu Yoshihiro. If he killed a formidable warrior like Yoshihiro, not only the other commanders but Ieyasu himself would surely see him in a new light. Determined to show the hereditary Tokugawa retainers who always mocked him, Tadayoshi swore to take Yoshihiro's head.
